topic.title: Why Berkshire Hathaway keeps a giant pile of cash instead of spending it

title: A cash pile this big is waiting for something 💰
description:
Is Berkshire Hathaway wasting its giant pile of cash?
The company Warren Buffett built holds $377.4B in cash: where it sits, what it earns, and what it's waiting for.
An animated story with illustrative numbers; the characters are not advisers.
Illustrative only. Not financial advice.
cta: Would you spend it or wait? Comment

lines.text: You think Berkshire's cash is wasted? It isn't.
Berkshire, the firm Buffett built, sits on one giant pile of cash.
Here's the trick: it sits in safe government bills, working.
At an assumed rate, it earns $15.10B a year, waiting.
But why would a company keep a pile this big?
Because when markets crash, prices drop, and cash buys first.
So is that pile wasted? No. It waits for a sale.
